name: TX-29
label: Safe D

key_factors: Strong Democratic district with a +17 partisan lean
Incumbent Sylvia Garcia seeking re-election with a large fundraising edge
Republican challenger Martha Fierro has raised no money
Prediction markets price Garcia's win probability near 97%
model.rationale: Garcia holds a heavily Democratic Houston-area seat, has out-raised an opponent who has reported no fundraising, and benefits from outside spending on her side. Markets and fundamentals both point to a comfortable double-digit win.
model.watch: Any late polling or outside spending against Garcia would be the first sign of a real challenge, but nothing currently suggests movement.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Sylvia Garcia, the Democratic incumbent, is running for re-election in a Houston-area district that leans Democratic by about seventeen points. She has raised nearly a million dollars and holds over $200,000 on hand, with outside groups adding more than half a million in support. Her Republican opponent, Martha Fierro, has reported no fundraising and no outside backing.

No public polls or expert ratings cover this race, so the outlook rests on district fundamentals, the money gap, and prediction markets, which price Garcia's chances near 97%. The combination points to a comfortable incumbent win with low uncertainty.
